decisions.reason: The whisk-style selection does not change the established 4.5 qt bowl capacity, depth, or acceptable refilling policy.
The source selects a whisk style for fine powder but does not alter the existing splash-minimization target.
The selected whisk is intended to support fine-powder performance, but the existing high-quality mixing and consistent-foam acceptance criteria remain unchanged.
The whisk-style decision does not necessarily change the enclosure thickness or maximum-size constraint.
The reference concerns the functional whisk-head style, not the machine's DJ-turntable visual identity.
The whisk-style selection does not change the branded placard text.
The source does not change the machine's beige primary color or green accents.
The source reference and design selection apply to the whisk, not the independently specified spout appearance.
Selecting a whisk-head style does not necessarily change the requirement to provide a basic wiring plan.
The whisk-style decision does not alter the controlled-pour, drip-prevention, flow-rate, or beverage-preservation requirements for dispensing.
The source selects a component design but does not change the system-layout deliverable or establish a new CAD requirement.
The whisk-head selection has no necessary effect on the requirement that the spout face the barista.
